notes.title: New update available
notes.content:
Thanks everybody for buying Onirike! We have listened to your suggestions and today we have released an update that includes:

- Option to disable subtitles
- Option to invert camera control
- Fixed some bugs.

[b]Don't forget to write your review about the game on Steam! It will help us a lot![/b]
